name: Wildtierbeobachtung im Karwendel
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The Karwendel Nature Park is one of the largest protected areas in the Alps. Join a guided hunt with a wildlife biologist to spot **Steinböcke** (mountain goats), **Gämsen** (ibex), **Murmeltiere** (dormice), and possibly even a **Steinadler** (eagle-owl) with luck. Recommended to wear camouflage clothing. Binoculars and telescopes are included in the price.
